description.text:
The type of constraint:
Look At - makes the source look at the target
Parent - modifies the prim's transformation as if the target was the parent hierarchically
Transformation - matches the location, rotation and scale of the prim to the those of the target
Translation - matches the location transformations of the prim to that of the target
Rotation - matches the rotation transformations of the prim to that of the target
Scale - matches the scale transformations of the prim to that of the target
Rotate
Scale
Translate
When enabled, the prim maintains the relative offset between itself and the target at the specified offset frame.
Orientation axis of the effect. Applies to following types of constraint: LookAt.
Rotate X
Rotate Y
Rotate Z
Set the frame to use to the current frame for maintain offset calculation.
Strength of the effect. Applies to following types of constraint: LookAt.

Coordinate system to use for extra transform:
Point - coordinate system at the target point
Prim - coordinate system of the target prim
World - world coordinate system
For LookAt: applied to the target point before constraint. Other modes: applied to the source prim after constraint
Index of the face to target

  • Pivot to: snaps the pivot location to a selection within the scene

When enabled the mask in this node is injected into the node directly below it if that node has the default path mask set.

Patterns to match prim names to using standard glob-style wildcards '*', '?'. There can be multiple mask patterns separated by spaces.
  • Default - selects the default prim(s) for the node. The default will be the injected mask prim paths if there is an upstream node with this. Otherwise the default mask for this node type is evaluated.
  • All Roots - selects the top level Xform(s) in your scene graph
  • Last modified - selects whatever the last node modified
  • All Cameras - selects all Cameras in your scene graph
  • All lights - selects all Lights in your scene graph
  • All Meshes - selects all meshes in your scene graph
  • Custom - sets a custom selection of prims that exist in your scene graph

Set your geometry or pivot location to that of a selection within the scene
  • Geo to selection (position): sets the position of your geometry to the selection within the scene
  • Geo to selection (position, orientation): sets the position and orientation of your geometry to the selection within the scene
  • Geo to selection (position, orientation, size): sets the position, orientation and size of your geometry to the selection within the scene
  • Pivot to selection (position): sets the pivot position to the selection within the scene
  • Pivot to selection (orientation): sets the pivot orientation to the selection within the scene
  • Pivot to selection (position, orientation): sets the pivot position and orientation to the selection within the scene

The target points:
Origin - the origin of the target object
Vertex - a fixed vertex number on the target mesh (must have normals to apply rotation)
Face - a fixed face number on the target mesh
The path to the target prim. This is the prim the source will be constrained to.

Allows specification of how much time offset is desired for the target point or the time to use for the target point.
Relative - allows targeting the past or future of the target point by specifying a time offset from the current time
Absolute - allows targeting the target point at a particular time by specifying a given time to use
A time offset for the constraint, allowing targeting the past or future of the target point
The absolute time for the constraint, allowing targeting the target point at a particular time

description.plain_text: Constrains an object to another object. You supply a number of source objects, a target object and a constraint. The transform of the sources will be animated to fit the constraint.
